## Summary
Describe the problem and the change. Link the issue/roadmap ID (use closing keywords only for work actually completed).

## Validation
Record the exact tested commit, commands/checks and results. Distinguish passed, failed, skipped and not run. Link CI evidence without secrets.

## Compatibility and rollback
Document configuration/dependency/schema changes, migration and rollback risks, or state why none apply.

## Security and release status
- [ ] I used synthetic/sanitized evidence and included no secrets or private content.
- [ ] Applicable tests and security checks pass; any unexecuted checks are explicitly listed.
- [ ] Findings above Low, unknown severity and incomplete required evidence remain release-blocking.
- [ ] This PR does not silently enable production payments, restricted publication or deployment.
